scope: synthetic paired stress; no measured experimental uncertainty supplied
normalization: same corrected-normalized raw vs relative delta vs signed-shape conventions, recomputed on same supported interior window
training: DCT16 C1 logistic, threshold.5; one paired augmentation, all views in original group
noise: 1% of each query peak; one shared reference vector plus independent sample/reference noise; shared component cancels in subtraction
shared_reference: same simulated reference per domain; noise common across test queries within fold; not independent references
gain: common acquisition gain changes shared divisor too and cancels; sample-only residual gain and processed divisor error separate
broadening: additional Gaussian sigma.25 eV on native pair, reflect finite-grid kernel; no removal of lifetime broadening
augmentation: shared±.2 eV plus residual±.2 eV; extra Gaussian sigma.25 eV; sample gain±5%; shared+independent noise1%; fixed illustrative settings
